key_concepts: Weather can be described as sunny, rainy, cloudy, windy, or stormy.
Sunny weather has bright sunshine and few or no clouds.
Rainy weather has a gray sky and falling water droplets.
Cloudy weather means the sky is covered with clouds.
Windy weather has strong moving air.
Stormy weather includes dark clouds and strong wind.
Temperature can be described as cold, warm, or hot.
Sky condition is one way to describe weather.
Weather can change from morning to midday to afternoon.
Weather can change from one day to the next.
Weather observations can be recorded using symbols and a chart.
Comparing weather records can show patterns such as which days were cloudy or rainy.
